        value = {i: sites_data[i]['value'] for i in sites_data}
        coords = {i: (sites_data[i]['avenue'], sites_data[i]['street']) for i in sites_data}

            ax, ay = coords[i]

        sites_data: Dict[int, Dict[str, int]] = message.message[0].data[0]
        
        # Helper to plan a route greedily by value per time spent
        def plan_route(sites):
            # convert time windows to minutes
            info = {}
            for sid, s in sites.items():
                info[sid] = {
                    'avenue': s['avenue'],
                    'street': s['street'],
                    'visit': s['desiredtime'],
                    'value': s['value'],
                    'begin': s['beginhour'] * 60,
                    'end': s['endhour'] * 60
                }

                best_score = -1.0
                best_arrival = None
                best_depart = None
                best_pos = None

                        score = s['value'] / total_time

                            best_sid = sid
                            best_arrival = arrival
                            best_depart = depart

                route.append(best_sid)
                current_time = best_depart
                current_pos = best_pos
                unvisited.remove(best_sid)

        duration = {i: sites_data[i]['desiredtime'] for i in site_ids}
        value = {i: sites_data[i]['value'] for i in site_ids}
        begin = {i: sites_data[i]['beginhour'] * 60 for i in site_ids}
        end = {i: sites_data[i]['endhour'] * 60 for i in site_ids}

        # Greedy builder starting from a given start site
        def build_from(start_id: int) -> Tuple[List[int], int]:
            # Try to visit start
            time = 0
            route: List[int] = []
            visited = set()
            # First leg: treat start as if at location, no travel
            travel = 0
            arrive = time + travel
            start_visit = max(arrive, begin[start_id])
            finish = start_visit + duration[start_id]
            if finish > end[start_id]:
                return [], 0
            time = finish
            route.append(start_id)
            visited.add(start_id)
            total_val = value[start_id]
            loc = start_id
            # Continue greedy
            while True:
                best_j = None
                best_score = 0.0
                best_finish = 0
                # Evaluate each candidate
                for j in site_ids:
                    if j in visited:
                        continue
                    # travel time = Manhattan distance
                    ttrav = abs(avenue[loc] - avenue[j]) + abs(street[loc] - street[j])
                    arr = time + ttrav
                    svis = max(arr, begin[j])
                    fin = svis + duration[j]
                    if fin > end[j]:
                        continue
                    added_time = fin - time
                    if added_time <= 0:
                        continue
                    score = value[j] / added_time
                    if score > best_score:
                        best_score = score
                        best_j = j
                        best_finish = fin
                if best_j is None:
                    break
                # Commit to best_j
                route.append(best_j)
                visited.add(best_j)
                total_val += value[best_j]
                time = best_finish
                loc = best_j
            return route, total_val

        # Select top candidate starts by raw value
        sorted_sites = sorted(site_ids, key=lambda i: value[i], reverse=True)
        P = min(10, n)
        best_route: List[int] = []
        best_value = -1
        for start in sorted_sites[:P]:
            route, val = build_from(start)
            if val > best_value:
                best_value = val
                best_route = route
        # Fallback: if nothing found, return empty
        visited_sites = best_route or []
        return Info(
            sender=self.__class__.__name__,
            receiver=message.sender,
            difficulty=message.difficulty,
            message=[BaseMessageDataType(data=visited_sites, type='custom')]
        )"}
